about: The Workbench icons of the Barrage drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amigaos3/icons.json --out amigaos3 (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/barrage.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/barrage.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Drawer.info is the drawer's own icon (package.sh copies it beside the drawer); Start Game.info and Start Full Screen.info are the two launchers'.
